title: opus: Fix padding handling
description:
According to RFC 6716, Opus padding appears at the end of the packet,
not immediately after the bytes indicating the padding size. The
value given by the varint indicates the number of additional padding
bytes, not including the padding size byte(s) (this makes it possible
to have one byte of padding, a size indicator of 0.)

Add the padding size as a field. Check if the padding is nonzero
and add an expert info if so.

Also, for some other error checking, the reported packet size,
not the captured length, should be used.
